code='''from collections import Counter

def transform(grid):
    h, w = len(grid), len(grid[0])
    counts = Counter(v for row in grid for v in row if v != 0)
    background = counts.most_common(1)[0][0]
    colors = [v for v in counts if v != background]
    color = min(colors, key=lambda v: counts[v])
    points = [(r, c) for r in range(h) for c in range(w) if grid[r][c] == color]
    r0, c0 = min(r for r, c in points), min(c for r, c in points)
    shape = [(r-r0, c-c0) for r, c in points]
    sh, sw = max(r for r, c in shape)+1, max(c for r, c in shape)+1
    out = [row[:] for row in grid]
    for r in range(h-sh+1):
        for c in range(w-sw+1):
            cells = [(r+dr, c+dc) for dr, dc in shape]
            if all(grid[rr][cc] == 0 for rr, cc in cells):
                for rr, cc in cells:
                    out[rr][cc] = color
    return out
'''
